title: Workflow chat is human-readable (nested activity, output, no backend IDs)
description:
Live MockLab research-lite completes, but the chat is still backend-shaped. Expanded stages say "No nested activity yet" even though helpers ran. The card shows complete 3/3 with no findings. The assistant echoes run_id. Citation chips dump state.json and opaque vault paths. Opening sample_document.txt fails with "vault returned HTML, not JSON".

Playbook: bug-fix + feature. QA first (artifacts/ui/lp-oop.38.25/QA.json, 02-expand-plan.png). Experience first: hide backend identity, show the work the user asked for.

Throughput checkpoint:
- Blocking: none. Live QA reproduced empty nest + visible run_id.
- Independent workstreams: (1) LA emit nest/summary, (2) Portal hide IDs + show outcome, (3) drop state.json citation chips, (4) vault citation open for real files.
- Shared mutable: ChatTimeline citation list vs WorkflowRunCard. Split by package (adapters-portal vs portal/apps/web vs BFF).
- Smallest safe: four leaves. 38.25.2 can ship without 38.25.1 if outcome is already on the terminal tool JSON.

Evidence: Nimbus thread 823bfc50, wf_249e3bb7c677e399, 02-expand-plan.png (No nested activity yet), 01-thread.png (run_id in bubble + sidebar). Prior 38.24 04-after-wait.png shows sample_document.txt and multiple state.json chips.
acceptance_criteria: A finished research-lite turn on MockLab shows: (1) expanded Plan/Explore/Synthesize list the helpers or a short stage summary, never "No nested activity yet" when work happened; (2) the card or follow-up text has the run outcome, not just 3/3 complete; (3) no wf_/run_id and no state.json chips in the chat; (4) clicking a real vault file citation opens the file, not an HTML-not-JSON error.
notes: QA 2026-08-23 Nimbus 823bfc50. findings=run_id_visible,no_nested_activity,no_subagent_rows. artifacts/ui/lp-oop.38.25/QA.json 02-expand-plan.png 01-thread.png. architect skipped: existing WorkflowRun + PortalWorkflowProgress shapes; fill summary/subagentIds rather than a new card. pstack: experience-first, prove-it-works, fix-root-causes.

notes:
Playbook: feature.md

architect skipped: locked IA already chose each interactive chat → one durable agent + that history, suffix on duplicate titles, no auto-channels. Two shapes sketched; arena skipped because the lock file is the synthesis.

Shape A (chosen): adopt the existing thread as the agent's one 1:1. Catalog row points at thread_id; history stays in place.

- Blocking first steps: uniqueLegacyAgentName + ChatThreadStore.migrateLegacyChatsToAgents, then I15/I16 fixture-DB tests.
- Independent workstreams: n/a — catalog and chat_threads share one writer.

Principles:
- model-the-domain: LegacyInteractiveChat vs ScheduledTaskStream vs already-bound agent; migration is a plan-then-apply over owner-scoped rows.
- foundational-thinking: unique name set + DurableAgent catalog row before write.

title: Harness workflow launch waits until run completes
description:

The Plan spawn_agent then waits forever (spawnWaitTimeoutMs default 0) on a nested LiteLLM child while the parent chat keeps calling the model. Tool result is launch-ack, not a finished run. Card never goes complete.

- Harness workflow launch (not validate_only) waits until the run is terminal (completed/failed/cancelled/budget_exceeded) or a bounded timeout, then returns that state.
- Nested spawn_agent has a bounded wait (not 0/unlimited).
- Existing harness-workflow tests still pass; add coverage that launch result status is terminal when the canned host finishes.

title: Workflow cards: flatten stages onto workflow_progress metadata
description:
Live MockLab QA (lp-oop.38.15) launched research-lite on https://app.withlanyard.com/mocklab. History events had Plan/Explore/Synthesize in a JSON string on metadata.result, but the chat cards showed "workflow · complete" + "Waiting for stages…" and two cards per run (LiteLLM call-* plus wf_*).

Cause: packages/adapters-portal/src/harness/tools-runner.ts onProgress calls buildToolProgressEvent with result: JSON.stringify(progress) only. Portal parseWorkflowStages reads metadata.stages, not metadata.result. First tool_progress uses the model tool_call_id; later snapshots use workflow_id.

Evidence: artifacts/ui/lp-oop.38.15/INSPECT.json and 22-thread-18375c12.png.
acceptance_criteria:
- Harness workflow_progress events include first-class metadata.stages, workflow_id, workflow_name, workflow_status (not only a JSON string in result).
- Portal mapper still accepts stages nested in result JSON as a fallback.
- One WorkflowRunCard per workflow_id (call-* start row merges into the wf_* run).
- Card lists Plan / Explore / Synthesize with statuses; "Waiting for stages…" only when stages are actually absent.
- Unit tests on tools-runner emit + mapWorkflowRunFromEvent / mapToolCallFields.
- Re-prove on live MockLab: screenshot of a card with the three stages, not Waiting for stages.
notes: Implementer: platform PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/580 SHA 7c34e266. LA companion https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-agent/pull/260 SHA e07f253. Portal unwraps nested result JSON onto stages/workflow_id and keys one WorkflowRunCard per workflow_id. LA onProgress now copies stages onto metadata. Tests: portal workflowRun+chatToolCallMapper+useChatEvents 121 passed; LA harness-workflow+chat-ui-events 19 passed. Residual: live MockLab screenshot after Portal deploy (current live events already carry stages in result JSON).
close_reason: Merged https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/580 (squash 98f07b2). Portal unwraps nested workflow_progress result JSON onto first-class stages/workflow_id and merges LiteLLM call-* into one wf_* WorkflowRunCard; live worktree QA rendered Plan/Explore/Synthesize on one card.

title: WhatsApp: wacli auth --events QR in chat, session.db to CP
description:
Why: QR pairing on the user sandbox, scannable in Portal. Design: docs/architecture/portal-connectors.md §6.
Run wacli auth --events on user sandbox. Host parses stderr NDJSON event=qr_code (do not send ASCII or payload to the LLM). portal_event connector.qr; SPA renders real QR from data.code; rotate on new event. Export session.db only to CP (never wacli.db/media). Restore + wacli sync on new sandbox. Passkey error fail-closed. whatsapp.send every_call.
acceptance_criteria:
[ ] Chat shows scannable QR (image from raw code), not terminal ASCII as primary UX
[ ] New qr_code events replace the same bubble
[ ] CP stores session.db ciphertext only; wacli.db never uploaded
[ ] New sandbox restores session without QR while device still linked
[ ] Unlinked device → needs_reauth + new QR
[ ] Proof: pairing event fixture + restore test; live QR scan if sandbox available
notes:
Playbook: feature.md
architect skipped: design is frozen in docs/architecture/portal-connectors.md §6.
